current_hypothesis: ECOS: a PPO policy over a restricted 5-operator library, conditioned on population state and real agent-execution feedback, optimizes discounted multi-step return of an evolution run and may outperform identical-state contextual bandits and hand rules on held-out task families — only if operator choice has non-myopic delayed effects (pre-training myopia diagnostic).
selection_rationale: M1 has a small discrete action space and permits controlled isolation of operator choice. This is a tractability decision, not a novelty claim.
central_falsification_risk: A contextual bandit using the same state features may match PPO; Phase 1 treats this as a core scientific test (myopia diagnostic + identical-state bandits), not a checkbox.

conditions.PC1: Myopia diagnostic must pass before any PPO/controller training
conditions.SR1: If decision problem is myopic → STOP PPO hypothesis (do not wrap bandit as RL)
conditions.SR2: Phase3: ECOS must beat identical-state contextual bandits on Family-C else STOP
conditions.SR3: A1 fitness-only / A0 no-execution-feature ablations equal to full ECOS → revise/stop
conditions.SR4: G3 causality: ≥3/5 operators must change observable behavior
conditions.SR5: Cost smoke infeasible → revise scale once then STOP

locked_design.genotype: declarative agent spec (system_prompt + tool subset + workflow), not free-form code
locked_design.ppo_vs_bandit_test: myopia diagnostic + equal-state bandit kill baselines; if myopic → STOP not wrap

current_task: Phase 2: implement genotype/interpreter/operators, task generators + manifest freeze, evolution loop, myopia diagnostic (PC1 gate), baselines B0–B6; then PPO trainer only after PC1 pass.
next_gate: G3_ENVIRONMENT_GATE (genotype causality + manifest freeze) then PC1_MYOPIA_GATE before G4_TRAINING_GATE
p0_1_conditions: C1: do not copy GLEET code; independent implementation only.
C2: choose exactly one decision family; M1 selected and designed, M2 frozen.
C3: bandit and FM-rewrite baselines are mandatory in effectiveness experiments.
C4: perform deeper literature collision check before publication-level novelty claims.
C5: if PPO fails to beat bandit on held-out task families, STOP this hypothesis; do not expand action space or stack modules.
acceptance_rules: Real LLM-agent execution outcomes ground the primary evaluation.
No novelty claims before mechanism-level related-work audit and deeper collision check.
Compare PPO against fixed, random, adaptive-rule, non-contextual bandit, contextual bandit (same state), FM-rewrite, and Q-learning baselines.
Use train/validation/held-out task-family separation and multiple seeds.
Limited-budget allocation is not the central contribution.
No controller implementation, model/API calls, training, or experiments during Phase 1 design task.
GLEET code must not be copied (no license).
Do not package a myopic operator-selection problem as RL to justify PPO; if myopic, STOP.
M2 frozen; no third mechanism to rescue STOP conditions.
